Summary: Audit existing AuraBookPro data model and plugin architecture
Acceptance Criteria:
- Business, service, staff, plan, type, coupon, wallet, and booking entities are mapped
- WordPress custom post types and metadata sources are documented
- Payment dependencies are identified
- Unknowns and risks are captured in migration notes

Summary: Define headless architecture and migration strategy
Acceptance Criteria:
- WordPress is defined as backend/admin system
- Next.js is defined as public frontend
- API strategy is approved
- Auth model is approved
- Deployment and rollback approach is documented

Summary: Create sprint plan and dependency map
Acceptance Criteria:
- Backlog is sequenced by dependency
- Each sprint has defined goals and deliverables
- Owner assignments are clear
- Dependencies are visible

- GET /wp-json/aurabookpro/v1/businesses returns paginated list
- Filters support category, city, search, and sort
- GET /businesses/:id returns a full record
- Public/private field separation is enforced

- GET /services returns public service records
- GET /services/:id returns a single service
- GET /types returns all types
- Pricing and duration fields are included
- Service-business relationships are mapped correctly

- GET /availability returns valid slots by date and service
- Staff-specific availability works
- Business hours and exceptions are respected
- Invalid dates return clear error payloads

Summary: Create customer auth and session API
Acceptance Criteria:
- Login API works with WP user credentials
- Registration API creates account and default role
- Logout invalidates session
- Password reset flow exists
- Unauthenticated requests are rejected appropriately

- GET /me returns authenticated customer profile
- PUT /me/profile updates valid profile fields
- Validation exists for name, email, phone, and address
- Unauthorized access is rejected

- POST /orders/create creates order and booking lock
- GET /orders/:id returns order data
- POST /payment/confirm processes callback
- Payment failure returns structured error
- Payment status transitions are consistent

- GET /me/wallet returns balances and transactions
